title: Cartwise+ Membership Declined-Fee Retry and Grace Schedule
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership period fee is declined, the membership is retried automatically and given a grace period. The per-plan terms are:

| Plan | Automatic retries of a declined fee | Days between retries | Grace period after becoming past due (calendar days) | Order benefits continue while past due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 3 | 3 | 10 | no |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 3 | 3 | 10 | no |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 3 | 3 | 10 | no |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 3 | 4 | 14 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 3 | 4 | 14 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 3 | 4 | 14 | yes |

## Column meanings

- **Automatic retries**: the number of automatic retries of a declined period fee.
- **Days between retries**: the spacing, in calendar days, between those automatic retries.
- **Grace period**: the number of calendar days after the membership became past due before it is canceled unpaid.
- **Order benefits continue while past due**: whether order benefits keep applying while the membership is past due.

## Comparison of the two groups

The three monthly plans share one set of terms (3 retries, 3 days apart, 10 grace days, benefits suspended while past due); the three annual plans share another (3 retries, 4 days apart, 14 grace days, benefits continuing while past due).
